package com.cowave.search.config

import co.elastic.clients.elasticsearch.ElasticsearchClient
import co.elastic.clients.json.jackson.JacksonJsonpMapper
import co.elastic.clients.transport.rest5_client.Rest5ClientTransport
import co.elastic.clients.transport.rest5_client.low_level.Rest5Client
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper
import com.fasterxml.jackson.datatype.jsr310.JavaTimeModule
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.kotlinModule
import org.apache.hc.core5.http.Header
import org.apache.hc.core5.http.HttpHost
import org.apache.hc.core5.http.message.BasicHeader
import org.springframework.boot.context.properties.ConfigurationProperties
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration

@Configuration
@ConfigurationProperties(prefix = "elasticsearch")
class ElasticsearchConfig {
    var url: String = ""
    var apiKey: String = ""

    @Bean
    fun esClient(): ElasticsearchClient {
        val host = HttpHost.create(url.removeSuffix("/"))

        val headers =
            arrayOf<Header>(
                BasicHeader("Authorization", "ApiKey $apiKey"),
            )

        val restClient =
            Rest5Client
                .builder(host)
                .setDefaultHeaders(headers)
                .build()

        val objectMapper =
            ObjectMapper()
                .registerModule(kotlinModule())
                .registerModule(JavaTimeModule())

        val transport = Rest5ClientTransport(restClient, JacksonJsonpMapper(objectMapper))

        return ElasticsearchClient(transport)
    }
}

    11→    val dictionaryRepository: DictionaryRepository,
    12→    val dictionaryBinaryCompile: DictionaryBinaryCompile,
    13→) {
    14→    fun getByType(
    15→        type: Type,
    16→        page: Int,

    25→

    27→        keyword: String?,

    29→        value: String?,
    30→    ) {

   122→    fun compileFromDictionaries(
   123→        dictionaries: List<Pair<String?, String?>>,
   124→        type: Type,
   125→        outputFile: File,
   126→        ignoreCase: Boolean = true,
   127→    ) {

   139→
   140→                Type.SYNONYM, Type.UNIT_SYNONYM -> {

   142→                    createSynonymFromPairs(dictionaries, ignoreCase)
   143→                }
   144→
   145→                Type.SPACE -> {
   146→                    // SPACE 타입: keyword -> value (공백 분리)
   147→                    createSpaceFromPairs(dictionaries, ignoreCase)
   148→                }
   149→
   150→                Type.COMPOUND -> {
   151→                    // COMPOUND 타입: keyword -> value (복합어 분해)
   152→                    createCompoundFromPairs(dictionaries, ignoreCase)
   153→                }
   154→            }
   155→        compile(type, data, outputFile)
   156→    }
   157→
   158→    /**
   159→     * SET 타입 사전 생성
   160→     */
   161→    fun createSetDictionary(
   162→        words: Collection<String>,
   163→        ignoreCase: Boolean = true,
   164→    ): SetDictionaryData = SetDictionaryData(words.toSet(), ignoreCase)
   165→
   166→    /**
   167→     * SYNONYM 타입 사전 생성 (keyword, value 쌍으로부터)
   168→     */
   169→    private fun createSynonymFromPairs(
   170→        pairs: List<Pair<String?, String?>>,
   171→        ignoreCase: Boolean,
   172→    ): SynonymDictionaryData {
   173→        val synonymMap = mutableMapOf<String, MutableList<String>>()
   174→        val wordSet = mutableSetOf<String>()
   175→
   176→        for ((keyword, value) in pairs) {
   177→            if (value.isNullOrBlank()) continue
   178→
   179→            val synonyms = value.split(",").map { it.trim() }.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
   180→
   181→            if (!keyword.isNullOrBlank()) {
   182→                // 단방향: keyword -> synonyms
   183→                val key = keyword.trim()
   184→                synonymMap.getOrPut(key) { mutableListOf() }.addAll(synonyms)
   185→                wordSet.add(key)
   186→                wordSet.addAll(synonyms)
   187→            } else {
   188→                // 양방향: 모든 단어가 서로 동의어
   189→                for (word in synonyms) {
   190→                    val others = synonyms.filter { it != word }
   191→                    synonymMap.getOrPut(word) { mutableListOf() }.addAll(others)
   192→                }
   193→                wordSet.addAll(synonyms)
   194→            }
   195→        }
   196→
   197→        return SynonymDictionaryData(synonymMap, wordSet, ignoreCase)
   198→    }
   199→
   200→    /**
   201→     * SPACE 타입 사전 생성 (keyword, value 쌍으로부터)
   202→     */
   203→    private fun createSpaceFromPairs(
   204→        pairs: List<Pair<String?, String?>>,
   205→        ignoreCase: Boolean,
   206→    ): SpaceDictionaryData {
   207→        val spaceMap = mutableMapOf<String, List<String>>()
   208→        val wordSet = mutableSetOf<String>()
   209→
   210→        for ((keyword, value) in pairs) {
   211→            if (keyword.isNullOrBlank() || value.isNullOrBlank()) continue
   212→
   213→            val key = keyword.trim()
   214→            val splitWords =
   215→                value
   216→                    .split(",", " ")
   217→                    .map { it.trim() }
   218→                    .filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
   219→
   220→            spaceMap[key] = splitWords
   221→            wordSet.add(key)
   222→            wordSet.addAll(splitWords)
   223→        }
   224→
   225→        return SpaceDictionaryData(spaceMap, wordSet, ignoreCase)
   226→    }
   227→

   229→     * COMPOUND 타입 사전 생성 (keyword, value 쌍으로부터)
   230→     */

   232→        pairs: List<Pair<String?, String?>>,
   233→        ignoreCase: Boolean,
   234→    ): CompoundDictionaryData {
   235→        val compoundMap = mutableMapOf<String, List<String>>()
   236→        val mainWordSet = mutableSetOf<String>()
   237→        val wordSet = mutableSetOf<String>()

   239→        for ((keyword, value) in pairs) {

   241→
   242→            val key = keyword.trim()
   243→            val parts =
   244→                value
   245→                    .split(",")
   246→                    .map { it.trim() }
   247→                    .filter { it.isNotEmpty() }

   249→            compoundMap[key] = parts

   251→            wordSet.addAll(parts)
   252→        }

   255→    }

### 6. Binary Compilation Pipeline

**Compiler:** `/Users/admin/project/admin/search-admin/src/main/kotlin/com/cowave/search/utils/DictionaryBinaryCompile.kt`

**Process Flow:**
```
ES Data (List<Pair<keyword, value>>)
    ↓
DictionaryBinaryCompile.compileToConfiguredPath()
    ↓
Type-specific data transformation (SetDictionaryData, SynonymDictionaryData, etc.)
    ↓
DictionarySerializer.writeTo()
    ↓
BinaryIO (VInt encoding, UString format)
    ↓
.dict files (output-path: ./data/dictionary)
```

**Type-Specific Compilation:**
- **SET types** (STOP, UNIT, USER, ENGLISH): `SetDictionaryData` - word sets only
- **SYNONYM types** (SYNONYM, UNIT_SYNONYM): `SynonymDictionaryData` - keyword → synonym list mapping
- **SPACE type**: `SpaceDictionaryData` - keyword → space-separated words
- **COMPOUND type**: `CompoundDictionaryData` - main word extraction with component words

**Output Files:**
- `stop.dict`, `unit.dict`, `user.dict`, `english.dict`
- `synonym.dict`, `unit_synonym.dict`
- `space.dict`, `compound.dict`

**Binary Format:** `/Users/admin/project/admin/search-admin/src/main/kotlin/com/cowave/search/utils/BinaryIO.kt`

- **VInt Encoding:** Lucene-style variable-length encoding (1-5 bytes per integer)
- **VLong Encoding:** Variable-length long encoding (1-9 bytes)
- **UString Format:** Unicode text (2 bytes per character)
- **Format:** VInt(byteLength) + chars (each 2 bytes)
- **Compatibility:** 100% compatible with Java analysis-product
